scope: Includes three suite containers; actual in-memory SQLite and supplied model metadata/contracts, not18 independent product acceptance workflows
changes: Removed semantic inference, durable disk persistence and circuit-breaker verification implications absent from assertions
Memory category assertion requires exact IDs, pagination checks disjoint offsets and empty final page
Pruning proves retention of old frequent and recent records, not just deletion of an old fixture
Model environment values restored and session store always closed on failed assertions
limits: No external inference, embeddings, real model health probe, browser workflow or file-backed restart in these three test sources
